name: LaFleur Minerals Inc.
summary: LaFleur Minerals Inc. explores for lithium and gold deposits in Canada. The company holds interest in the Swanson Gold Project that consist of 445 mineral claims and1 mining lease covering an area of 18,300 hectares located in city of Val-d’Or, Québec; and beacon gold mill and property consist of 11 mining claims and 1 mining located in the Abitibi Gold Belt in Quebec. LaFleur Minerals Inc. is based in Vancouver, Canada.
